_comment: Used only with --det. For every scenario, each mode in modes.json needs a list of questions. An entry is either a plain string (standard complexity and length) or an object {"text": ..., "complexity": "simpler|standard|more_challenging", "length": "shorter|standard|longer"}. Questions whose tags match the current style preferences are preferred.

normal: What do you think was the most important moment in this story?
What surprised you most about what happened at recess?
What do you think should happen next in this story?

normal.text: What happened to Maya at recess?
Why do you think Maya didn't tell anyone how she felt about what happened at recess?

feelings: How do you think Maya felt when Leo said they already had enough people?
How do you think Maya felt when she saw another kid join the game without asking?
Why do you think Maya didn't want to go to recess the next day?

feelings.text: How did Maya feel on the bench?
How might Maya's feelings change if someone came over to sit with her?

perspective_taking: Why do you think Leo said they already had enough people?
What do you think the kid who joined without asking was thinking?
How do you think the other kids playing tag saw what happened?

perspective_taking.text: If Leo knew how Maya felt the next day, what do you think he would think about what he said?

personal_experience: Can you think of a time when you felt left out of a game or group?
Have you ever seen someone get left out, like Maya did?
What helps you feel better when you've been left out?

personal_experience.text: Has anyone ever said no when you asked to play?
When have you been the one deciding who gets to join a game or group?

problem_solving: What could Maya do the next time she wants to join a game?
What could Leo have said instead of 'we already have enough people'?
What might happen if Maya told a teacher how she felt?

problem_solving.text: If Maya invited other kids on the bench to start a new game, what might happen next?

normal: What do you think was the biggest problem in this story?
What do you think will happen the next time Sam and Priya work together?
Which part of this story felt the most real to you?

normal.text: Why do you think finishing the poster alone didn't feel as fun as Sam expected?

feelings: How do you think Priya felt when she said 'Fine, do whatever you want'?
How do you think Sam felt while he finished the rocket alone?
Why do you think the poster didn't feel as fun for Sam at the end?

feelings.text: How might Sam and Priya each feel the next time they see the poster at the fair?

perspective_taking: Why do you think Priya wanted to draw the ocean so much?
What do you think Priya meant when she said 'Fine, do whatever you want'?
How do you think Sam saw the argument?

perspective_taking.text: What do you think each friend wished the other one understood about the poster?

personal_experience: Can you think of a time you and a friend wanted to do something different ways?
Have you ever said 'fine' when you didn't really feel fine?
What do you usually do when you disagree with a friend?

personal_experience.text: Have you ever argued with a friend?
When did you and someone else find a way to combine both of your ideas?

problem_solving: What could Sam and Priya have done to include both of their ideas?
What could Sam say to Priya now?
What might happen if Sam asked Priya to help finish the poster?

problem_solving.text: If they had to make another poster together next week, what could they agree on before they start?

normal: What do you think was the turning point in this story?
What do you think the group should do with the ten minutes left?
What part of this story stood out to you most?

normal.text: Why do you think the group went quiet after Jordan knocked the cups down?

feelings: How do you think Jordan felt after the tower fell for the third time?
How do you think Ava felt when Jordan knocked the cups down?
Why do you think Jordan got so frustrated?

feelings.text: How do you think Jordan felt a minute after he said 'This is stupid'?

perspective_taking: What do you think Ava was thinking when the group went quiet?
How do you think the other teammates saw what Jordan did?
What do you think the teacher was hoping the group would do?

perspective_taking.text: Why might Jordan's frustration look different to his teammates than it felt to him?

personal_experience: Can you think of a time when you got really frustrated while working on something?
What do you do when something you're building keeps going wrong?
Have you ever been on a team where someone got upset?

personal_experience.text: When has getting frustrated changed how a group project went for you?

problem_solving: What could Jordan do when he starts to feel frustrated?
What could Jordan say to Ava now?
What could the group try differently to keep the tower from falling?

problem_solving.text: If the group took a short break before trying again, how might that change what happens in the last ten minutes?
